lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Madagascar to estimate acutely food insecure populations under different scenarios. The resulting estimates represent post-event or current-situation impact assessments of food insecurity, classified as loss data reflecting population vulnerability to drought-driven food crises.
